checks: Civil branch time is converted to UTC regardless of server time zone; eight retries create one appointment and notice
Distinct concurrent public and internal intentions cannot double-book the same professional
Any-barber availability stays free when another professional is occupied and concurrent allocation uses both safely
Branch closing, professional hours, accented rest days and invalid dates fail without changing customer records
Branch-wide blocks affect every barber and block creation races atomically with booking
No four-hour lookback: a long historical appointment beginning the day before blocks the interval
Service duration and price come from the catalog, never caller estimates
Public booking cannot overwrite existing customer name or email
Public lookup contains no customer name, phone, notes or management token
Public reprogramming requires a valid capability, preserves one appointment and rejects occupied targets
Cancellation is repeatable, does not fake a WhatsApp or waitlist delivery, and cannot reopen
An expired management capability cannot change an appointment
Concurrent status completion and repeated no-show each count the customer once; absence before appointment end fails
Durable public limits span two API processes and replays do not consume another quota
Foreign branch and barber inputs never create customer or booking effects
DST ambiguous and missing civil hours are rejected, explicit instants and day boundaries remain precise
Wrong tenant slug cannot replay a cancelled capability; duplicate reprogramming produces one audit
A barber can create and move their own appointment but cannot move another professional
Attended appointment has one sale under concurrent payment and never adds a second CRM visit
Working database stays unchanged
datos: Ficticios; dos procesos API; sin mensajes externos ni datos operativos
